title: fix(plugin-approvals): name a no-approver position by its label at the decide refusal and the submitter notice; translate the approver-type word
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3T2gwH6MWTYde4qF8edEDN)_

Fixes #36308

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：审批没人能批时，提交人收到的通知和自己审批被拒时的提示，都改用岗位的显示名；中文等语言里「岗位」「团队」「部门」这类词也不再显示英文。
- 为什么做：审批收尾这一组工作的一部分。之前只有审批时间线上的说明用了显示名，另外两处仍显示内部名。
- 出错会怎样：只影响这几句提示的文字，审批结果和已保存的审计记录都不变，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

When a request opens on a slate that names no one but its submitter, three doors name the remedy. Before this PR only the timeline note named a position by its label. The decide refusal and the submitter's notice used the position's internal name, and the approver-type token (`position`) stayed English in all eleven packs.

- **Approver-type words and slot clauses** (`translations/messages.ts`, all eleven packs). Four type words were added: `approvalApproverTypePosition`, `…Team`, `…Department` and `…OrgMembershipLevel`. Each `en` word is the machine token. Each slot is one `approvalNoApproverSlot` clause (`{{type}} '{{value}}'`, quoted the way each pack quotes), joined by `approvalNoApproverSlotSeparator`. A zh-CN reader now reads `担任岗位「销售经理」的成员`. A slot of any other type (a stored `role:` or `queue:` slot, a `bu` dialect) keeps its token, as the administrators' note does. In zh-CN, zh-Hant and ja-JP, `approvalNoApproverHolding` loses the spaces around `{{who}}`, because the hole now holds a word in that language.
- **Decide refusal** (`approval-service.ts`, both the `excludeSubmitter` refusal and the override refusal). The remedy is composed only when the refusal is thrown. Positions go through `notePositionLabels`, the one resolver the timeline uses: the decider's pack label, then the declared label, then the name. The sentence stays English, and the door does not split `message`/`userMessage` for `FORBIDDEN`.
- **Submitter notice** (`approval.comment`). A notice is rendered per recipient at delivery, and a keyed param there is one hole-free key. So a slate of one slot uses the new `approvalNoApproverHoldingSlot`: the same sentence with the slot inline, `type` keyed to the type word, and a position's `value` keyed to `positions.NAME.label` with fallback declared label, else the name. The declared half is read through `notePositionLabels` (called without reader labels). A slate of several slots still sends one English `who`, with each position named by its declared label (see Acceptance notes).
- `notePositionLabels` now takes `labels: ReaderLabels | undefined`. With none, it reads only the declared label.
- The English the row stores is unchanged byte for byte: the `en` type words are the tokens, and the stored comment is still composed with no labels.

Landing spot: the claim's surface (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/**` and a changeset). The diff does not edit `packages/spec/src/**`.

## First reads (by risk)

1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/no-approver-note.ts`: `slotClause` / `noApproverWho` (render fallbacks) and `noApproverNotice` (the single-slot keyed shape).
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`: the decide hunk around `noApproverRemedy` (now lazy and async; both refusals keep their wording), and the notify hunk.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/messages.ts`: the new keys in each pack.

## Tests

- New `no-approver-note.test.ts`:
  - the English is unchanged;
  - zh-CN names each of the four types by its word, and no shipped non-en pack spells a type token;
  - position-only labelling;
  - fallbacks when a pack lacks a clause, a type word or the sentence;
  - a legacy stored `who` is kept;
  - the notice's keyed shape, rendered the way the messaging renderer does it (pack label, then declared label, then name);
  - in every pack, the notice's inline sentence equals the timeline's sentence for the same slot.
- `admin-rescue-named-slate.integration.test.ts` (`[#36035]` block):
  - flipped pins: zh-CN `岗位「销售经理」` with no `position` token; ja-JP `役職「Sales Manager」`; unlabelled `岗位「treasury」`; the legacy `who` control now uses the no-space zh template;
  - new: the submitter's notice, opened through the labelled service and rendered by the real `NotificationTextRenderer`. zh-CN reads `岗位「销售经理」`, the literal body uses the declared label, and an unlabelled position keeps its name.
- `exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts`:
  - the existing `holds position 'legal'` pin stays as the unlabelled control, on a service that knows no label;
  - new: the override refusal names `position '法务'` for a zh-CN decider whose pack holds the label, and `position 'Legal Counsel'` (the declared label) for ja-JP and for no locale, beside an unchanged `team 'ops'`;
  - new: the `excludeSubmitter` refusal names the declared label.

## Acceptance notes

- **Filed:** the multi-slot notice and refusal-language gaps below are carried by #36463 (p3, Blocked-by #36450), filed by the seat.
- **Multi-slot notice.** A notice for a slate of two or more slots still carries one English `who` inside the reader's sentence (`担任position 'Legal Counsel', team 'ops'的成员`). The messaging service fills a keyed param with one hole-free key, so a list of clauses cannot be rendered per recipient without a nested-param shape in `@objectstack/service-messaging`, which is outside this card's surface. The single-slot slate (an organization of one, the case the card names) is fully localized. The timeline note and the refusal compose any number of slots. Carried by #36463.
- **Refusal language.** The decide refusal stays an English sentence with the label inside it, as the card's Done-when asks. The approvals REST mapper answers `FORBIDDEN` as `{ code, error }` with no `userMessage` channel (`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`), so a reader-language refusal would be a REST change. Carried by #36463.
- **Legacy stored `who`.** A note stored before slots existed (an English `who`) now renders `担任position 'sales_manager'的成员` in zh-CN, with no spaces, because the CJK sentence lost its spaces. The stored comment is unchanged.
- **Administrators' note.** That note (`approvalAdminRescueSlotUnresolved`) still names non-position types by their token. Not touched: it is outside this card's sentence.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/no-approver-note.test.ts`. Expect 8 passing tests, including "a zh-CN reader reads every approver type by its word, and no English type token".
